envelopes.name: foreign
envelopes.note: Not an envelope at all.

envelopes.name: newer-layout
envelopes.note: A layout byte above 1 belongs to a newer Tisty.

envelopes.name: newer-format
envelopes.note: A manifest version above 5 belongs to a newer Tisty.

envelopes.name: older-format
envelopes.note: No format below 5 is read.

envelopes.name: wrong-key
envelopes.note: Another key fails at the commitment, before any part is opened.

envelopes.name: flipped-part
envelopes.note: A sealed byte that no longer matches the index.

envelopes.name: flipped-part-new-index
envelopes.note: The index was rewritten too, so the seal is what catches it.

envelopes.name: swapped-parts
envelopes.note: Two parts traded places, with their sizes and hashes, and the nonce catches it.

envelopes.name: changed-version
envelopes.note: The manifest changed after sealing, so no part opens.

envelopes.name: truncated
envelopes.note: The last part was cut short.

envelopes.name: trailing-bytes
envelopes.note: Bytes past the last part.

envelopes.name: no-signature
envelopes.note: Part 1 has to be the writer's signature.

envelopes.name: words-not-last
envelopes.note: The words have to come last.

envelopes.name: no-sheet
envelopes.note: A version without a sheet shows nothing.

envelopes.name: unfolds-past-len
envelopes.note: A part may not open to more than its manifest says.

envelopes.name: spelled-another-way
envelopes.note: The sender's signature is taken only in the one spelling.

envelopes.name: not-a-picture
envelopes.note: The bytes do not start like the kind they declare.

envelopes.name: signed-for-another-link
envelopes.note: The writer signed for another id, so that signature is refused.
